blocks.note: Build cardinal numbers across tens, hundreds, thousands, and the milhão/bilhão scale while preserving agreement, conjunction placement, and de before a directly governed noun.
Expand written ordinals, inflect every component for the qualified noun, and contrast ordinary compounds with the rare large ordinal forms retained by the source set.
Produce dates with cardinal day numbers except primeiro, insert de between date fields, and read years as ordinary cardinal numbers.
Express conversational and scheduled clock times with singular or plural ser, feminine hour numerals, articles after prepositions, and both past-hour and para alternatives.
Integrate fractions, meio versus metade, decimal commas, percentages, monetary amounts, and regnal numbers in a final mixed numerical-expression block.
